description: This file defines the Device Runtime Power Management API for Zephyr OS, including function declarations, macros, and inline stubs for managing device power states and runtime PM features.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_auto_enable
methods.description: Automatically enables device runtime based on devicetree properties; not to be called from application code.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_enable
methods.description: Enables runtime power management for a device; suspends device if active.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_disable
methods.description: Disables runtime power management for a device; resumes device if suspended.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_get
methods.description: Resumes a device based on usage count; can be called in contexts where blocking is allowed.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_put
methods.description: Suspends a device based on usage count.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_put_async
methods.description: Schedules suspension of a device asynchronously after a delay.

methods.name: pm_device_runtime_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if device runtime PM is enabled for a device.
